anomalies.observed: Both MCUs' VCAP pins are assigned signal nets, with no required VCAP-to-GND capacitors shown. FCC2 VCAP pins connect to NET0100 and NET0152; NAVC2 VCAP pins connect to NET0089 and NET0170. NET0100 and NET0152 appear on the UART3_FCC2 connector, and NET0089 appears on the I2C3_NAVC2 connector.
anomalies.expected: Each MCU's VCAP pins should have the datasheet-required capacitors to ground and should not be used as external signal nets.

evidence.quote: VCAP 48 NET0100; VCAP 73 NET0152 (FCC sheet, page 2/6)
UART3_FCC2: NET0100, NET0152 (FCC Peripherals sheet, page 5/6)
VCAP_1 31 NET0089; VCAP_2 47 NET0170 (NAVC sheet, page 3/6)
I2C3_NAVC2: NET0039, NET0089 (NAVC Peripherals sheet, page 6/6)

anomalies.impact: The MCUs' internal core regulators may not operate correctly without their required VCAP capacitors, preventing reliable startup or operation. Routing these regulator-output pins to external connectors also risks loading or disturbing the core supply.

parsed.summary: Both MCU symbols show VCAP pins routed onto signal nets rather than to the required local capacitors. At least some of those nets reach external connectors, making this a significant power-integrity and MCU-operation anomaly.
